_doc: qal/vtreq -- THE DELVTO (THRESHOLD) REQUIREMENT SWEEP. The user asked 'can QAL be faster?'; the campaign's answer on SG13G2 was NO and reduced to one device number, |Vtp| = 0.4403 V against a ~0.75 V hop-delivered rail. This run converts that into a REQUIREMENT and measures what buying it costs. Every number MEASURED / DERIVED / ASSUMED.

_provenance.pyms_vae_cache: scratchpad/vae_cache_vtreq -- MY OWN, built from scratch, nothing copied in
_provenance.shim: the committed qal/sg13lv_compat.sp VERBATIM plus DELVTO={DVTN} / DELVTO={DVTP} on the M cards, driven by two global .param values. PYMS_CALLBACK_PARAMS=DELVTO keeps DELVTO symbolic in the vae .so (verified on disk: the generated eval.cpp contains double DELVTO = _pcb("DELVTO"); and VFB_T = ... + DELVTO_i - 0.69967...), so one .so per geometry serves the whole sweep.
_provenance.lower_bound_caveat: shim_dvt.sp inherits the committed shim's ZEROED ad/as/pd/ps, so junction capacitance is ABSENT everywhere. Every capacitance, charge, energy, hop time and settling time here is a LOWER BOUND. It cuts BOTH ways in this study: the missing drain junction cap is part of what would HOLD a collapsing HIGH up and part of what would SLOW a creeping LOW.
_provenance.shallow_stack_caveat: every number is SHALLOW-STACK (inverter bank) except the section (f) o21ai rows.
_provenance.energy_exclusion_untouched: the committed energy EXCLUSION verdict (23.213 fJ/bank/hop vs a pre-stated <= 12.7467 fJ, stat-sim c814e52) is NOT reopened and NOT affected by anything here.
_provenance.body_bias_still_parked: the user PARKED body bias until real PDKs are in hand. This run does NOT un-park it. DELVTO here is a DEVICE-PARAMETER SENSITIVITY SWEEP answering 'what would be needed'. There is no FDX PDK on this machine and no claim is made that any technology delivers the thresholds below.

G0_instrument_check.amendment: A1 -- the pre-registration quoted the lsw/.measure-path t_hop; the same-path sk anchor is the correct comparand and is reproduced at rel 6.9e-13.

G1_does_DELVTO_reach_the_devices.cross_terms: EXACTLY ZERO -- |Vtp| identical to 6 decimals on all five nMOS-only rows, Vtn identical to 6 decimals on all five pMOS-only rows
G1_does_DELVTO_reach_the_devices.note: the sweep parameter is not silently ignored -- this campaign's oldest failure mode is closed here by measurement, not assertion.

Q1_THE_LEVEL.question: at what threshold does the QAL level at the ALU's real 6.91 fF mean sink load reach parity with, then beat, a SAME-DELVTO CMOS logic level?
Q1_THE_LEVEL.comparator: CMOS_dev = the IDENTICAL campaign cell (1.12 um pMOS / 0.74 um nMOS, l = 0.13 um) on a fixed 1.20 V DC rail, driving the IDENTICAL 6.91 fF load, ideal 2 ps input edge, time to 90% of its own rail, WORST of rise and fall. Both sides carry the same cell, the same load and the same shift. The committed 92.8 ps figure is a SYNTHESIS/STA number and cannot be DELVTO-swept, so it enters only through the relative-gain layer.

DELVTO_0_anchor.note: the device-level comparator lands within 1.5% of the committed STA anchor at DELVTO = 0, which is why the two layers agree.

pre_registered_form_L_fixed_at_4nH.ratio_worst_edge: 1.2261 -> 1.0052 over the sweep (best = both devices at -0.30 V)
pre_registered_form_L_fixed_at_4nH.verdict: PARITY NOT QUITE REACHED (0.5% short); a BEAT not reached.

L_reoptimised_EXPLORATORY_amendment_A5.why_it_is_legitimate: t_hop = pi*sqrt(L*C/2) contains NO threshold and is MEASURED invariant (+0.11% over the whole sweep) while t_settle collapses x0.42, so the hop becomes 50% of the level at the deepest shift. At DELVTO = 0 the rail-drain gate C2 EXCLUDED small L (VA_open +0.263 at L = 1 nH); at -0.30 the same row reads +0.099 and passes. The threshold shift is what RE-ADMITS the small inductor.
L_reoptimised_EXPLORATORY_amendment_A5.on_the_MEAN_edge_convention: parity NOT reached anywhere -- best 1.0467. The difference between the conventions is entirely the campaign cell's 1.83:1 rise/fall imbalance (94.17 vs 51.38 ps), a CELL-SIZING property, not a QAL property. Re-sizing the cell is untested here and is the obvious next lever.

Q1_THE_LEVEL.THE_MECHANISM: the residue is the HOP. It is an LC time with no threshold in it. Lowering Vt collapses the settle term but cannot touch the hop; the only thing the threshold buys against the hop is INDIRECT -- a stronger switch re-admits a smaller inductor.

Q2_THE_CHAIN.question: at what threshold does HIGH/LOW separation stay above the noise floor to depth 3, 5, 10?
Q2_THE_CHAIN.vehicle: qal/restore5 rest.py k = 6 NO-RESTORE control, 6 hop-powered banks, no buffer of any kind, L = 15 nH, W = 30 um, dV = 1.2, T = 300 ps
Q2_THE_CHAIN.metric: min(pull-UP output) - max(pull-DOWN output) at each bank's own stage boundary, SIGNED, mV. NEGATIVE means the stage carries INVERTED data, not weak data.

floor.ASSUMPTION: sigma_Vt is ASSUMED INDEPENDENT of DELVTO (delvto_mm is an absolute-volts sigma on the same additive parameter being swept). Sensitivity reported per row.

Q2_THE_CHAIN.DEPTH_3: MEASURED reachable: |Vtp| <= 0.2395 V WITH Vtn <= 0.3240 V, or |Vtp| <= 0.1391 V alone.
Q2_THE_CHAIN.DEPTH_4: MEASURED reachable at |Vtp| = 0.1391 V AND Vtn = 0.2240 V (separation +8.33 mV, 2.4x the floor).
Q2_THE_CHAIN.DEPTH_5: NOT REACHED ANYWHERE. Best depth-5 separation in the whole sweep is +0.0597 mV, 57x below the PDK sigma_Vt, and of the WRONG SIGN (-0.0044 mV) at the most favourable point.

DEPTH_10.status: NOT SIMULATED -- DERIVED, and the derivation is given in full because it is load-bearing

rail_collapse_MEASURED.why_threshold_does_not_help: the collapse is a fixed per-hop CHARGE against the bank's incremental capacitance (chain3), i.e. a charge/capacitance ratio; it is 0.66 at DELVTO = 0 and 0.61 at the deepest shift -- slightly WORSE, because lower-Vt cells draw more.

DEPTH_10.THE_SPEC: a restoring CMOS gate needs |Vt| well below its own supply to have any gain. At depth 10 that supply is 6-14 mV, so the required |Vtp| is BELOW ~10 mV -- within ~3 sigma of ZERO against this PDK's own sigma_Vt of 3.42 mV. A threshold whose mean sits 3 sigma from zero cannot be manufactured to work: a large fraction of devices would be depletion-mode and would never turn off. QAL'S UNBUFFERED CHAIN AT DEPTH 10 NEEDS A THRESHOLD NOBODY CAN BUILD.

Q2_THE_CHAIN.sigma_Vt_sensitivity: depth 4 at the deepest shift (+8.33 mV) would fail only if sigma_Vt were 2.4x the PDK value; depth 5 would pass only if sigma_Vt were 57x SMALLER. The depth >= 5 verdict is insensitive to any plausible mismatch model, and at the deepest shift depth 5's SIGN is wrong, which no mismatch floor can rescue.
Q2_THE_CHAIN.E2_scoring: the DC mechanism I pre-registered is CONFIRMED as DC physics (the stranded HIGH tracks |Vtp| at 0.81:1; the receiver trip point moves -0.485 V/V of pMOS DELVTO and +0.463 V/V of nMOS DELVTO, so the DC gap strand-minus-trip is OPENED by lowering |Vtp| and CLOSED by lowering Vtn) but REFUTED as the binding term: the measured chain gets BETTER when |Vtp| falls, because at a collapsed rail the limiter is the successor's own pMOS PULL-UP. Right physics, wrong term, and it is recorded as a miss.

Q3_THE_COST.question: at what point does the cure cost more than the disease?
Q3_THE_COST.it_is_an_nMOS_ONLY_cost: IN THIS HELD-BANK CONFIGURATION ONLY: every pMOS-only row is identical to the DELVTO = 0 row to 12 digits, because the pull-down cells' pMOS are REVERSE-gated (gate at VGH = 1.65 V, source at the 0.75 V rail, Vsg = -0.90 V) and the pull-up cells' pMOS are ON. The DEVICE-level pMOS off-current does rise with DELVTO_P -- MEASURED 7.614e-12 -> 4.611e-08 A at the delivered rail (6057x, ~84 mV/decade, the same slope as the nMOS) -- and would count in any bias arrangement that leaves a pMOS at Vgs = 0. The nMOS-only result is a property of the committed bank's gate drive, not of the pMOS.
Q3_THE_COST.ANSWER: THE CURE DOES NOT COST MORE THAN THE DISEASE ANYWHERE IN THE SWEPT SPACE. At the deepest shift the held rail loses 1.3-4.3 mV per 120 ps beat against a 754 mV rail (0.17-0.57%), still 5-20x smaller than the committed measured -20.2 to -28.6 mV settling-era hold droop. DERIVED: the beat period at which leakage equals the measured 15.2-29.1 fJ delivered per bank per hop falls from ~72 us to ~16 ns -- still ~130x longer than a 120 ps beat.
Q3_THE_COST.E3_scoring: direction and slope CONFIRMED (I predicted 80-100 mV/decade, measured 82); MAGNITUDE REFUTED (I predicted >100 mV of droop per beat; measured 1.3-4.3 mV).

f_THE_2_HIGH_STACK.cell: sg13g2_o21ai_1 topology, the Vortex ALU's dominant mapped cell, driven through the 2-HIGH series pMOS stack; l = 0.13 um where the mapped netlist uses 0.15 um, so GENEROUS to QAL
f_THE_2_HIGH_STACK.verdict: E4 CONFIRMED -- the 2-high stack gains MORE than an inverter from the same shift, because it loses two threshold drops in series where an inverter loses one. BUT IT DOES NOT CHANGE CLASS: 4.77x a same-load, same-DELVTO CMOS level at the most favourable threshold in the sweep. THE SHALLOW-STACK LIBRARY RESTRICTION STANDS, and a threshold shift does not lift it.

THE_ANSWER_IN_ONE_PARAGRAPH: QAL needs |Vtp| <= 0.24 V at a 0.74 V delivered rail (with Vtn <= 0.32 V) to reach PARITY with a same-threshold CMOS logic level at the ALU's real 6.91 fF load, and |Vtp| <= 0.14 V at a 0.74 V rail (with Vtn <= 0.22 V) to BEAT it by 12%. Against SG13G2's actual |Vtp| = 0.4403 V that is a 0.20 V and a 0.30 V threshold reduction respectively -- large, but not absurd, and the leakage it costs is measured and does not bind. So the SPEED wall moves. What does NOT move is the CHAIN: the same shifts buy exactly one extra bank of usable logic depth each (1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 banks), because the thing killing the chain is not a threshold but a rail that collapses by a MEASURED 0.61-0.66 per hop -- a charge-over-capacitance ratio that a threshold cannot touch, and that gets slightly WORSE as Vt falls. Carrying data to the depth-10 sha_slice the throughput case needs would require the cell to work at a 6-14 mV supply, i.e. |Vtp| below ~10 mV, which is within 3 sigma of ZERO against this PDK's own 3.42 mV threshold spread. THAT is a threshold nobody can build. The honest summary: a reachable threshold makes the QAL HOP faster than CMOS; no threshold makes the QAL PIPELINE exist.

WHAT_THIS_CHANGES_AND_WHAT_IT_DOES_NOT.changes: the committed line 'at the real load QAL's level is SLOWER than a CMOS level everywhere in the PDK envelope' (stat-sim 88a0306) is a DELVTO = 0 statement. At |Vtp| <= 0.24 V it is false, measured. The committed 'no reachable knob moved it' becomes 'no knob IN THE PDK ENVELOPE moved it; the threshold does, and the amount needed is 0.20-0.30 V.'
WHAT_THIS_CHANGES_AND_WHAT_IT_DOES_NOT.does_not_change: the pipeline verdict. chain3/skip4/restore5 concluded that QAL cannot form an unbuffered pipeline on this node; this run measures that a 0.30 V shift on both devices buys depth 4 instead of depth 1, and that depth 5 is unreachable at any swept value. MAX k = 1 (a restoring buffer between every bank) is not repealed by any threshold -- it is relaxed to roughly MAX k = 4 at a threshold nobody has offered to build, and the throughput case needs 10.
WHAT_THIS_CHANGES_AND_WHAT_IT_DOES_NOT.the_next_lever_this_run_points_at: NOT the threshold. The chain's wall is the rail-collapse ratio 0.61-0.66/hop, which is charge-over-capacitance. The levers that attack THAT are a larger source bank / unequal bank ratio, or a keeper/latch per output -- i.e. the register back. Separately, the Q1 comparator's 1.83:1 rise/fall imbalance says the campaign CELL is unbalanced; re-sizing it is untested and would move both sides.
